<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0032026-09-0303-46-31" status="unreviewed">
         <milestone n="gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug gi brgyud pa" unit="section"/>   
         yang gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug gi brgyud pa ni | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3745">jo bo rje</rs> | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7029">lha btsun pa byang chub 'od</rs> | 'ol ba byang chub rdo rje | rgya lcags ri gong kha ba | rdzing bu kha pa | thang stod pa chos kyi 'od | zhang yes | gze ba don grub mgon | bar thang pa yab sras | dar ma shAkya | bsod nams dbang phyug lo tsA ba mchog ldan | bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston kha che | byang chen 'jam rings pa | kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang | des bdag la gnang ba lags so || </seg></TEI>
